programmes.department: Department of Business Management & Industrial Administration
programmes.evidence: Official FMS 2026 doctoral admissions bulletin (p. 12) describes the full-time PhD in Management and explicitly lists Operations Management & Decision Science among major areas of specialization; candidates must choose a listed research area and the selection is area-specific. Current FMS doctoral page independently names the same research area.
limitations: Operations Management & Decision Science is a named PhD specialization/research area, not a separately awarded degree. Distinct from the Department of Operational Research PhD.

branches.conclusion: Current FMS Doctoral Programme page and 2026 admissions bulletin fully list the PhD in Management specializations: Operations Management & Decision Science; Management of Information Technology; Organizational Behaviour & HRM; Marketing; Strategy/General Management/Economics; Finance. The first is the only named qualifying business route. FMS is a Faculty of Management Studies, not itself a department titled Operations.

Current central PhD subject list has Operational Research but no separate Industrial Engineering title. Main department directory omits Production & Industrial Engineering, whereas the official March 2026 Academic Council roster still retains a head position for that department marked Vacant, and older university history confirms founding in 1998. Neither administrative post nor historical identity establishes active current IE PhD provision; technical branch remains partial pending a current faculty/doctoral host source. An official 2013 PhD awardee roll names two recipients from Production and Industrial Engineering, establishing historical doctoral output but not 2026 current intake.
